$comment: Source of truth for the CloudzLab Salesforce plugin catalog. scripts/sync.py reads this file; edit it, then re-run the sync.

catalog.name: cloudzlab
catalog.description: CloudzLab team catalog: Salesforce skills from forcedotcom/sf-skills that Salesforce does not ship in an official plugin, grouped into team plugins.

officialPlugins.$comment: Every official plugin must be listed as core or specialist. The sync flags any new official plugin that is in neither list.

specialistKeywords.$comment: Finder trigger words for official specialist plugins.

teamPlugins.name: sf-platform-extras
teamPlugins.description: General Salesforce tools not in an official plugin: official docs lookup, ApexGuru scan, SLDS design system, org shapes and snapshots, data masking, AI model setup, Flow planning, diagrams and extra Agentforce setup. Includes sf-plugin-finder and sf-npx-cleanup.
teamPlugins.areas: Platform tools, DX tooling, SLDS, Flow planning, Agentforce setup

teamPlugins.name: sf-experience-extras
teamPlugins.description: Experience Cloud site configuration beyond components: LWR sites, portals, custom domains, navigation menus, notifications, Lightning Out and page setup.

teamPlugins.name: sf-data360
teamPlugins.description: Data 360 (Data Cloud): data streams, data model objects, identity resolution, segments, calculated insights, activations, semantic models and knowledge graphs.

teamPlugins.name: sf-field-service
teamPlugins.description: Field Service: scheduling policies, work plans and rules, data capture forms, mobile branding and technician pre-work briefs.

teamPlugins.name: sf-omnistudio
teamPlugins.description: OmniStudio: OmniScripts, FlexCards, Integration Procedures, DataMappers, EPC product catalog and DataPack deployment.

teamPlugins.name: sf-commerce
teamPlugins.description: Commerce beyond B2B storefront components: B2B store setup, delivery estimates, BOPIS, fees, returns, merchant catalogs and buyer groups, merchant insights and React storefronts.
teamPlugins.areas: Commerce (B2B/D2C store setup, fulfilment, merchant tools)

teamPlugins.name: sf-service-itsm
teamPlugins.description: IT Service Management and other Service Cloud setup: incidents, CMDB, IT service agents, Slack and Teams channels, SLAs, contact center and service catalog.
teamPlugins.areas: IT Service Management, Service Cloud extras

teamPlugins.name: sf-fsc
teamPlugins.description: Financial Services Cloud: digital loan origination, pricing, product catalog, stage management, flexible account hierarchies and document checklists.

teamPlugins.name: sf-health-cloud
teamPlugins.description: Health Cloud: appointment booking, provider search, care requests, referrals, virtual visits and the patient timeline.

teamPlugins.name: sf-industries
teamPlugins.description: Settings shared across Industry clouds: decision tables and matrices, contact center, home health, care management, fundraising, compliance and document AI.

teamPlugins.name: sf-consumer-goods
teamPlugins.description: Consumer Goods Cloud: store visits and activities, trade promotions, promotion dashboards and data sync.

teamPlugins.name: sf-automotive
teamPlugins.description: Automotive Cloud: dealer setup, vehicle appraisals, sales concierge agents and their data pipelines.

teamPlugins.name: sf-crm-analytics
teamPlugins.description: CRM Analytics and Tableau Next: dashboards, report notifications, sharing inheritance and Tableau Next setup.

teamPlugins.name: sf-industries-misc
teamPlugins.description: Smaller packs: Communications Cloud, Nonprofit (fundraising, volunteers), Life Sciences, Insurance, Sales (call scoring) and Marketing.
teamPlugins.areas: Communications, Nonprofit, Life Sciences, Insurance, Sales, Marketing

ownedSkills.$comment: Team-written skills copied verbatim into a team plugin.

ownedHooks.$comment: Team-written hooks copied verbatim into a team plugin's hooks/ folder.
